title: Novel Multiparametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging-Based Deep Learning and Clinical Parameter Integration for the Prediction of Long-Term Biochemical Recurrence-Free Survival in Prostate Cancer after Radical Prostatectomy.
summary: Pretrained EfficientNet-B0 derived deep MRI features combined with clinical variables in Cox-LASSO; in 437 single-center prostatectomy cases, 110 BCR events, five-fold CV gave combined model C-index .89/iAUC .93 vs clinical-only C-index .81. Internal CV only; retrospective. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
